import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final long MOD = 1000000007L;

    static long fastPow(long a, long p) {
        if (p == 0) return 1;
        long half = fastPow(a, p / 2);
        half = (half * half) % MOD;
        if (p % 2 == 1)
            half = (half * a) % MOD;
        return half;
    }

    static boolean solve(Scanner sc, PrintWriter pw, boolean multipleTestMode) {
        if (!sc.hasNextLong()) return false;
        long p = sc.nextLong();
        long k = sc.nextLong();

        if (multipleTestMode && !sc.hasNextLong()) return false;

        // LOCAL_PRINT equivalent: we can ignore or use System.err
        // System.err.println("Next test: " + p + " " + k);

        if (k == 0) {
            long ans = fastPow(p, p - 1);
            pw.println(ans);
            return multipleTestMode;
        }

        if (k == 1) {
            long ans = fastPow(p, p);
            pw.println(ans);
            return multipleTestMode;
        }

        int size = (int) p + 1;
        boolean[] used = new boolean[size];
        long groups = 0;
        long ans = 1;

        for (long x = 1; x < p; x++) {
            int idx = (int) x;
            if (used[idx]) continue;

            groups++;
            ans = (ans * p) % MOD;

            used[idx] = true;
            long v = x;
            long next = (v * k) % p;
            while (!used[(int) next]) {
                v = next;
                used[(int) v] = true;
                next = (v * k) % p;
            }
        }

        pw.println(ans);
        return multipleTestMode;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        PrintWriter pw = new PrintWriter(System.out);

        // In the original code, ONLINE_JUDGE mode uses single test, else multiple tests.
        // We'll assume multiple tests (read until EOF) for simplicity, as local testing.
        // To match the original behavior, we could check for a system property, but we'll just do multiple.
        while (solve(sc, pw, true)) {
            // continue
        }

        pw.flush();
        pw.close();
        sc.close();
    }
}
